scope: Lexically nested try parallel blocks in mixed CPU/GPU main using the existing bounded TaskCore.

semantics.groups: Open each block with its lexical parent. CPU calls, GPU calls and explicit transfers use the active group. Close and resumably join each block before proceeding.
semantics.results: Completed float32 scalars and rank-one/rank-two tensors may leave a block. Tensor residency and immutable backing ownership are preserved; no implicit transfer is inserted.
semantics.bindings: Inner bindings may shadow outer names. Duplicate names within a block reject; inner bindings do not escape. Surrounding binding annotations provide type/shape context for a final literal.
semantics.tasks: Tasks born in the block must be observed before close. Task handles and device selectors cannot be returned. An ancestor task may be observed inside a nested group of the same supervisor.
semantics.failure: Existing cancellation and task settlement retain child captures and pending GPU completions until cleanup. Failed or quota-exhausted scopes fail the invocation.
semantics.quotas: Existing runtime depth, group-storage, ready-queue and task limits apply. Group control records remain retained until the supervisor retires, including sequential lexical groups.
semantics.limits: Lexical scopes in mixed main only. No asynchronous ordinary CPU helper bodies, mixed-source recovery, new numeric types or shared placement-aware task/residency IR.

coverage: Inner value shadows outer value without changing it
Resident GPU result used after inner group joins
Ancestor task observed inside inner scope
Depth two, three-group and one-slot ready limits fail with complete cleanup; two-slot ready queue progresses
Cancellation, group deadline and failed GPU completion while nested compute is held

cli.dynamic_fault: Inner CPU child with unknown fixed-shape precondition fails with shape code 1 and no result under 1/2/4 workers.

compiler_asan_ubsan: Sanitized compiler generated the nested source fixture successfully.
distributed_execution: Not implemented; design-review gate retained in docs/roadmap.md.
performance: Source integration and correctness work; no speedup claim.
